name: MATS (ML Alignment & Theory Scholars)
summary: A research training programme for AI safety in Berkeley and London: scholars spend ten to twelve weeks on a research project with a mentor from an AI lab or safety research group (interpretability, oversight and control, evaluations, governance), and many continue in a funded extension phase. It began in 2021 and became its own US charity, MATS Research, Inc. (EIN 99-0648563), in 2024.

spending.source: https://apps.irs.gov/pub/epostcard/990/xml/2025/2025_TEOS_XML_11B.zip (MATS Research, Inc., Form 990 for 2024, Part IX line 25: programme services $2,215,834 of $2,926,442 total expenses; Part III line 4a, the MATS programme, $1,191,653; line 4b, general programmes and events held for alumni, $1,024,181. The return reports audited financial statements, which aren't published. Scholars' stipends were paid by AI Safety Support and aren't in this spending.)
